verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM is a SaaS CRM, and any software product could publish its source under an open license, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public source repository or an open-source license. The pack covers only the API, integrations, data export and features of the proprietary service, none of which counts as open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
